private JsonSchema createJsonSchema(Object validationContext) throws Exception {
    Constructor<?>[] ctors = JsonSchema.class.getDeclaredConstructors();
    Constructor<?> ctor = ctors[0];
    ctor.setAccessible(true);
    int paramCount = ctor.getParameterCount();
    Object[] args = new Object[paramCount];
    // all nulls
    JsonSchema instance = (JsonSchema) ctor.newInstance(args);
    // set field
    Field f = JsonSchema.class.getDeclaredField("validationContext");
    f.setAccessible(true);
    f.set(instance, validationContext);
    return instance;
}
